<summary>Tool use: **replace_string_in_file**</summary>

**Input:**

- newString:

```
// ============================================================================
// Dyfuzory (nawilżacze) — 2 dyfuzory, naprzemienne w trybie AUTO
// ============================================================================
void diffusers_control(const SensorData& data) {
  DiffuserConfig& dc = configMgr.cfg.diffusers;
  if (dc.count == 0) return;

  // Tryb ręczny — każdy dyfuzor sterowany osobno
  if (diffuser_manual_mode) {
    diffuser_on = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < dc.count && i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
      bool on = (i < 2) ? diffuser_manual_on[i] : false;
      if (dc.pins[i] >= 0) digitalWrite(dc.pins[i], on ? HIGH : LOW);
      if (on) diffuser_on = true;
    }
    return;
  }

  float hum_min, hum_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(hum_min, hum_max);
  float target = (hum_min + hum_max) / 2.0f;

  unsigned long elapsed = millis() - diffuser_change_ms;
  bool prev_on = diffuser_on;

  if (data.humidity >= 0) {
    // Hystereza: włącz jeśli wilg < target-5, wyłącz jeśli > target+10
    if (data.humidity < target - 5.0f) {
      if (!diffuser_on) { 
        diffuser_on = true; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
    } else if (data.humidity > target + 10.0f) {
      if (diffuser_on) { 
        diffuser_on = false; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
    } else {
      // Tryb cykliczny: co off_time_sec wyłącz, co on_time_sec włącz
      unsigned long on_ms  = (unsigned long)dc.on_time_sec  * 1000;
      unsigned long off_ms = (unsigned long)dc.off_time_sec * 1000;

      if (diffuser_on && elapsed > on_ms) { 
        diffuser_on = false; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
      if (!diffuser_on && elapsed > off_ms) { 
        diffuser_on = true; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
    }
  }

  // Przy przejściu ON→wybranie dyfuzora naprzemiennie
  if (diffuser_on && !prev_on) {
    int cnt = min(dc.count, (int)MAX_DIFFUSERS);
    if (cnt > 0) {
      diffuser_active_idx = diffuser_next_idx % cnt;
      diffuser_next_idx   = (diffuser_active_idx + 1) % cnt;
    } else {
      diffuser_active_idx = 0;
    }
  } else if (!diffuser_on) {
    diffuser_active_idx = -1;
  }

  // Steruj GPIO — tylko aktywny dyfuzor pracuje, pozostałe wyłączone
  for (int i = 0; i < dc.count && i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    if (dc.pins[i] >= 0) {
      bool on_this = diffuser_on && (i == diffuser_active_idx);
      digitalWrite(dc.pins[i], on_this ? HIGH : LOW);
    }
  }
}
```

```
// ============================================================================
// Dyfuzory (nawilżacze)
// ============================================================================
void diffusers_control(const SensorData& data) {
  DiffuserConfig& dc = configMgr.cfg.diffusers;
  if (dc.count == 0) return;

  // Tryb ręczny — pomija automatykę
  if (diffuser_manual_mode) {
    diffuser_on = diffuser_manual_state;
    for (int i = 0; i < dc.count && i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
      if (dc.pins[i] >= 0) digitalWrite(dc.pins[i], diffuser_on ? HIGH : LOW);
    }
    return;
  }

  float hum_min, hum_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(hum_min, hum_max);
  float target = (hum_min + hum_max) / 2.0f;

  unsigned long elapsed = millis() - diffuser_change_ms;

  if (data.humidity >= 0) {
    // Hystereza: włącz jeśli wilg < target-5, wyłącz jeśli > target+10
    if (data.humidity < target - 5.0f) {
      if (!diffuser_on) { 
        diffuser_on = true; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
    } else if (data.humidity > target + 10.0f) {
      if (diffuser_on) { 
        diffuser_on = false; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
    } else {
      // Tryb cykliczny: co 300s wyłącz, co 60s włącz
      unsigned long on_ms = (unsigned long)dc.on_time_sec * 1000;
      unsigned long off_ms = (unsigned long)dc.off_time_sec * 1000;

      if (diffuser_on && elapsed > on_ms) { 
        diffuser_on = false; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
      if (!diffuser_on && elapsed > off_ms) { 
        diffuser_on = true; 
        diffuser_change_ms = millis(); 
      }
    }
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < dc.count && i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    if (dc.pins[i] >= 0) {
      digitalWrite(dc.pins[i], diffuser_on ? HIGH : LOW);
    }
  }
}

async function toggleDiffuserPower(idx,on){
  if(idx>=0&&idx<2){ state.power.diffuser[idx]=!!on; } else { state.power.diffuser=[!!on,!!on]; }
  savePowerPref(); applyPowerUI();
  const st=document.getElementById('st-diff');
  setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Aktualizacja dyfuzora…');
  try{
    if(!on){
      const idxArg=(idx>=0&&idx<2)?'&idx='+idx:'';
      const r=await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?on=0'+idxArg,{method:'POST'}); const d=await r.json();
      setMsg(st,d.ok?'ok':'err',d.ok?'✓ Dyfuzor '+(idx>=0?idx+1:'')+' odcięty':'✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
      return;
    }
    if(state.runtime.diffuserManual){
      const idxArg=(idx>=0&&idx<2)?'&idx='+idx:'';
      const curOn=idx>=0&&idx<2?state.runtime.diffuserOn[idx]:(state.runtime.diffuserOn[0]||state.runtime.diffuserOn[1]);
      const r=await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?on='+(curOn?1:0)+idxArg,{method:'POST'}); const d=await r.json();
      setMsg(st,d.ok?'ok':'err',d.ok?'✓ Dyfuzor przywrócony (ręczny)':'✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
    } else {
      const r=await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?auto=1',{method:'POST'}); const d=await r.json();
      setMsg(st,d.ok?'ok':'err',d.ok?'✓ Dyfuzory → AUTO':'✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
    }
  }catch(e){ setMsg(st,'err','✗ Brak połączenia'); }
}
```
